svg.text: Port names are today's bpu_qmv_engine; colours mark what the 10-03-26 slides change.
a write accepted in cycle t is
seen by reads accepted after t
mat_cmd_t: proposed packed struct (today: a flat 154-bit body, bpu_isa_pkg Mb* offsets)
a_type 3 INT4 | INT8 | INT16 | UINT16 | INT32
shift 6 fraction bits f to shift out, round-to-nearest-even
accumulate 1 c += result (OUTER) instead of c = result
argmax 1 write only the largest row's index (LM head; exists today)
m, n, k 3x20 dimensions (n reaches 248,320 for the LM head)
a, b, c 3x64 views: base address + row stride; a and b in, c out
wid 16 weight tensor id, only if weights stream (exists today)
Open decisions that change these ports
-> keep or drop the memory-manager group
-> scale streams ws_* stay, change or go
INT4/8/16 data in SRAM needs byte addresses
4. Read bandwidth: OUTER reads S, k and Δ;
GEMV reads A and x -> NRdPorts
mat_cmd_t is our proposal to them
